name: refinely-v3-poc
description: Local POC for a grounded, lean Refinely V3 pipeline.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js --requirement "Create a coordinated launch plan with research tasks, vendor reviews, materials, effort estimates, approval packets, and follow-up purchase orders."
scripts.demo:gemini: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js --provider gemini --requirement "Create a coordinated launch plan with research tasks, vendor reviews, materials, effort estimates, approval packets, and follow-up purchase orders."
